title: KPRS to stage protest on Nov. 20

ai.summary: Karnataka Prantha Raitha Sangha (KPRS) accuses insurance companies of underreporting crop losses in Kalaburagi district, demanding full compensation for 4.52 lakh farmers affected by drought.

facts.claim: KPRS district president Sharanabasappa Mamshetty said that crops have been damaged across 5,55,032 hectares owing to drought
facts.quote: crops have been damaged across 5,55,032 hectares owing to drought

facts.claim: KPRS district president Sharanabasappa Mamshetty said that insurance companies are considering only the initial stage of crop damage while ignoring losses during pod formation and the yield stage
facts.quote: insurance companies are considering only the initial stage of crop damage while ignoring losses during pod formation and the yield stage

facts.claim: As many as 4.52 lakh farmers have enrolled under the crop insurance scheme and ₹67.87 crore has been collected as premium
facts.quote: As many as 4.52 lakh farmers have enrolled under the crop insurance scheme and ₹67.87 crore has been collected as premium

facts.claim: Pointing to the mounting agrarian distress, he said that 22 farmers have been found dead in the district till June this year
facts.quote: Pointing to the mounting agrarian distress, he said that 22 farmers have been found dead in the district till June this year

facts.claim: The KPRS, along with other farmers organisations, will stage a protest outside an insurance company’s office on November 20 if the authorities fail to resolve the issue by then
facts.quote: The KPRS, along with other farmers organisations, will stage a protest outside an insurance company’s office on November 20 if the authorities fail to resolve the issue by then

ai.background_note: Karnataka Prantha Raitha Sangha (KPRS) is a farmers' organisation in Karnataka that has been protesting crop insurance issues since 2025.
ai.importance_reason: 2 outlets in the last 48 hours; coverage up from 0 to 1 reports this week.
